purpose: Character status HUD concepts only; no game implementation changed.

1.name: Pocket character dossier
1.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI concept for an existing Chinese illustrated campus life card game. This is a visual proposal for the character status panel only, not a redesign of the game.
Input image 1: actual game screenshot, reference for the exact character, warm watercolor dorm-room atmosphere, paper card design language and original gameplay. Input image 2: zoomed original character HUD, reference for the exact data values and field names. Actually use both attached images.
Target dimensions: a natural 1200 x 720 landscape close-up presentation of the lower-left character/HUD region, not the whole tall screen. Keep the girl's face, navy hoodie, bun hairstyle, notebook-holding pose, and watercolor illustration identity recognizable and faithful to image 1. Place the existing character on the left, the redesigned status card beside her lower torso on the right, integrated over the SAME muted warm dorm background. Crop out unrelated upper food cards, avoid inventing extra rooms, and avoid adding any UI, gameplay controls, decorative props or labels. The status card must be clearly legible at presentation scale, with generous spacing, no clipped text. This is game UI, not a corporate analytics or medical dashboard.
Maintain the game's card feeling and handmade paper warmth: muted parchment cream, fine warm-brown ink outline, dark cocoa type, gentle sage accents, subdued slate-blue study progress, very subtle paper grain, restrained soft shadow. No pure white large surfaces, glass, glossy plastic, shiny metal, neon, bright saturated all-green borders, ornate fantasy gold, generic app tiles, cards nested inside cards, decorative emoji, bezel, browser chrome, watermarks or option labels.
Use the exact data, never fabricate values: '余力 65', '精力 52', '心情 55', '饱腹 58', '压力 48', '复习 0/70'. A small non-button tag may read '起步' to represent the existing start state. The '…' details button belongs neatly in the status card's top-right corner and retains the original function. Preserve all six numerical fields, don't hide the study goal. Normal attributes use calm subtle accents; the four attribute indicators do NOT look like four independent action buttons. Body Chinese typography is crisp, consistent and comfortably readable, no meaningless explanatory copy or header title. Current real-world date is 2026-10-09; do not add a date or substitute it for in-game day data.
Use alignment, typography and spacing first, very light rules second. Only one character status card plus the existing character and muted environment. No new interaction model: hover details and click-to-open details remain conceptually as in the existing game.
Direction name: Pocket character dossier. Information hierarchy: '余力' and a prominent '65' grouped together at upper left in a single header row, a tiny '起步' tag and small ellipsis at upper right. Beneath, a balanced two-by-two grid of plain printed attribute readouts: energy and mood on the first row, satiety and stress on the second row. Each readout has label at left and number at right above a very thin sage tick strip. No cell border or cell background. A light horizontal divider separates the footer: '复习 0/70' with a restrained full-width slate-blue progress rule, correctly empty at zero. Compact softly rounded paper card, portrait remains the visual anchor, polished implementation-ready detail.
